description: Independent test of the Rollins mimicry claim: rigid structural superposition of AcrIF3 onto PA14 Cas8f, with Cas7f as control
code:
import requests, numpy as np, time
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"research/1.0"})
AA3={'ALA','ARG','ASN','ASP','CYS','GLN','GLU','GLY','HIS','ILE','LEU','LYS','MET','PHE','PRO','SER','THR','TRP','TYR','VAL','MSE'}
def parse(text):
    lines=text.splitlines(); i=0; cols=[]; rows=[]; n=len(lines)
    while i<n:
        if lines[i].startswith('_atom_site.'):
            while i<n and lines[i].startswith('_atom_site.'): cols.append(lines[i].strip().split('.')[1]); i+=1
            while i<n:
                ln=lines[i]
                if ln.startswith('#') or ln.startswith('loop_') or ln.startswith('_') or ln.strip()=='': break
                rows.append(ln.split()); i+=1
            break
        i+=1
    idx={c:k for k,c in enumerate(cols)}; return idx,[r for r in rows if len(r)==len(cols)]
def cas(pid,chain):
    idx,recs=parse(S.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.cif",timeout=200).text)
    d={}
    for r in recs:
        if r[idx['auth_asym_id']]==chain and r[idx['label_atom_id']]=='CA' and r[idx['label_comp_id']] in AA3:
            d[int(r[idx['auth_seq_id']])]=[float(r[idx['Cartn_x']]),float(r[idx['Cartn_y']]),float(r[idx['Cartn_z']])]
    ks=sorted(d); return np.array(ks), np.array([d[k] for k in ks])

def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc=P.mean(0);qc=Q.mean(0);V,s,Wt=np.linalg.svd((P-pc).T@(Q-qc))
    dd=np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@Wt)); R=V@np.diag([1,1,dd])@Wt; return R,pc,qc
def app(X,R,pc,qc): return (X-pc)@R+qc

t0=time.time()
kq,Q = cas("5GNF","A")           # AcrIF3 protomer
kt,T = cas("6NE0","A")           # PA14 Cas8f / Csy1
print("AcrIF3 CAs:",len(Q)," PA14 Cas8f CAs:",len(T), "range", kt.min(), kt.max())
tree=cKDTree(T)
best=None
FL=10
for i in range(0,len(Q)-FL,2):
    P0=Q[i:i+FL]
    for j in range(0,len(T)-FL,2):
        R,pc,qc=kabsch(P0,T[j:j+FL])
        M=app(Q,R,pc,qc)
        d,_=tree.query(M)
        n4=int((d<4.0).sum())
        if best is None or n4>best[0]: best=(n4,R,pc,qc,i,j)
n4,R,pc,qc,i0,j0=best
# refine
for it in range(6):
    M=app(Q,R,pc,qc); d,idx_=tree.query(M); sel=d<4.5
    if sel.sum()<10: break
    R,pc,qc=kabsch(Q[sel],T[idx_[sel]])
M=app(Q,R,pc,qc); d,idx_=tree.query(M); sel=d<4.0
rms=float(np.sqrt((d[sel]**2).mean())) if sel.sum() else float('nan')
print(f"Best superposition AcrIF3 -> PA14 Cas8f: {sel.sum()} CA pairs within 4.0 A, RMSD {rms:.2f} A")
print("Cas8f residues matched (auth numbering):", sorted(set(kt[idx_[sel]].tolist())))
print("AcrIF3 residues matched:", sorted(set(kq[sel].tolist())))
print("elapsed", time.time()-t0)

# control: same search against an unrelated chain (Csy3/Cas7f, 6NE0 chain C)
kt2,T2=cas("6NE0","C"); tree2=cKDTree(T2); best2=None
for i in range(0,len(Q)-FL,2):
    P0=Q[i:i+FL]
    for j in range(0,len(T2)-FL,2):
        R2,pc2,qc2=kabsch(P0,T2[j:j+FL])
        d,_=tree2.query(app(Q,R2,pc2,qc2)); n=int((d<4.0).sum())
        if best2 is None or n>best2[0]: best2=(n,R2,pc2,qc2)
n2,R2,pc2,qc2=best2
for it in range(6):
    M2=app(Q,R2,pc2,qc2); d,ix=tree2.query(M2); s2=d<4.5
    if s2.sum()<10: break
    R2,pc2,qc2=kabsch(Q[s2],T2[ix[s2]])
d,ix=tree2.query(app(Q,R2,pc2,qc2)); s2=d<4.0
print(f"\nControl (AcrIF3 vs Cas7f/Csy3, chain C): {s2.sum()} CA pairs <4.0 A, RMSD {np.sqrt((d[s2]**2).mean()):.2f} A")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7,4))
ax.bar(["Cas8f (Csy1)\ntarget","Cas7f (Csy3)\ncontrol"],[int(sel.sum()),int(s2.sum())],color=["#2E6F95","0.7"])
ax.set_ylabel("AcrIF3 CA atoms superposed within 4.0 A")
ax.set_title("Structural similarity of AcrIF3 (5GNF) to PA14 Csy subunits (6NE0)\nfragment-seeded rigid superposition, 139-residue AcrIF3 protomer",fontsize=10)
for s in ("top","right"): ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
